implementation: Arxan Cryptographic Key & Data Protection AES Component
description: Arxan Cryptographic Key & Data Protection, a state-of-the-art Whitebox Cryptography, transforms crypto keys and data so neither can be discovered while at rest or at runtime. It supports AES algorithm in whitebox form to protect sensitive keys and data in hostile or untrusted operational environments.
